subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — post-call recap
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — post-call recap

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we have the same picture before I pull together a formal quote:

Summary of what we heard
- Workloads: interactive chat + embeddings for search and reranking. Primary model family: 70B–100B open models (mix of chat and instruction).
- Expected steady-state volume: ~1.0–1.4B tokens / month (you mentioned 1.2B as a likely target).
- Burst/peak: up to ~200–300 qps (short bursts during business hours).
- Target unit economics: you said target is ~ $600–800 / 1M tokens (team target $/1M).
- Constraints: 12-month committed term preferred; SOC2 + EU data residency are checkboxes for later in the process.

Dedicated capacity options we discussed (high-level)
- GPU choices: A100 80GB vs H100 80GB. H100 gives ~25–40% higher throughput for your model family but at a premium.
- Recommended starting configs (ballpark):
  - 8 x A100 (80GB) => ~2,400 tokens/s aggregate (good cost-per-GPU but lower tail-latency headroom)
  - 6 x H100 (80GB) => ~2,700 tokens/s aggregate (better for lower-latency burst handling)
- Typical Willis numbers: H100-based clusters are better if you need tighter tail latencies during bursts; A100 works if cost is the main driver and bursts are smaller.

Estimated budget range (very preliminary)
- Committed reserved capacity (6x H100): ~ $70k–85k / month (includes base support and reserved throughput). Equivalent effective price ~ $580–720 / 1M tokens at 1.2B tokens/mo.
- Committed reserved capacity (8x A100): ~ $55k–70k / month. Equivalent effective price ~ $460–600 / 1M tokens at 1.2B tokens/mo.
- Overage pricing and burst credits will be defined in the formal quote — typically a blended overage of ~ $900–1,100 / 1M tokens.

Requested next steps
1) Can you confirm the target monthly token volume you want us to size the quote for (1.0B vs 1.2B vs 1.5B)?
2) Are you comfortable with a 12-month committed term?
3) Please confirm procurement contact (I copied Carlos if that’s correct).
4) If yes to the above, I’ll send a formal quote + a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and schedule a 30–45 minute technical deep-dive with our infra lead (Marissa) to validate throughput and SLA requirements.

Attached: high-level pricing sketch (Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf) and a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_Q2.xlsx).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emma Li <emma@finlytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — post-call recap

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming our inputs so you can size a formal quote:

Confirmed numbers
- Likely steady-state: 1.2B tokens / month (will start lower but need headroom).
- Peak burst target: ~250 qps (5–10 minute bursts during NY market open).
- Preferred committed term: 12 months — procurement prefers annual commitments for budgeting.
- Target blended budget: ~$80k / month (this is our internal target; willing to trade term/commit for better pricing).

Questions for the quote
- Can you include both A100 and H100 options with expected throughput and expected effective $/1M tokens at 1.2B?
- What is the SLA for availability and response time for reserved clusters?
- Data residency: EU region required for some subsets of our traffic (we can scope later).

Procurement contact: Carlos Mendez (carlos.procure@finlytics.com) — he will own the SOW + PO once we have the formal quote.

If you can send a draft quote this week, we’ll try to review with Carlos + our security team (SOC2 questions) and book the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Emma Li
Director of Search & Relevance | Finlytics
emma@finlytics.com | +1 (646) 555-0188

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — post-call recap

Emma / Carlos — thanks for confirming. Based on the 1.2B token target and the burst profile, here’s our recommended starting configuration and a rough price outline I’ll fold into the formal quote later today:

Recommended configuration (primary)- 6 x H100 (80GB) reserved cluster- Expected sustained throughput: ~2,700 tokens/s aggregate (supports 250 qps bursts with headroom for routing and KV-cache)- Effective committed price (estimated): $75,000 / month

Alternate configuration (cost-first)- 8 x A100 (80GB) reserved cluster- Expected sustained throughput: ~2,400 tokens/s aggregate- Effective committed price (estimated): $60,000 / month

Estimated unit economics (at 1.2B tokens/mo)- 6x H100 reserved: ~ $625 / 1M tokens effective
- 8x A100 reserved: ~ $500 / 1M tokens effective

Notes on overage and burst handling- We include burst credits to handle short spikes; sustained overages billed at an overage rate (ballpark) $900–1,000 / 1M tokens.
- We can also recommend a hybrid config (reserve A100 for steady-state + a small H100 hot-pool for bursts) if you want to optimize cost vs tail latency.

Next steps I’ll take now
1) Prepare a formal quote (A100 and H100 variants) + MAP and send to Emma + Carlos by EOD.
2) Marissa — can you join a technical deep-dive Thursday or Friday this week? I’ll propose slots after I share the quote.
3) Carlos — if you can share your standard PO timeline and any procurement templates, I’ll make sure the quote aligns.

Attaching the pricing sketch and MAP (attached). Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/deal/DL-78321

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Internal note — looping here: good baseline. A couple internal items to include before sending final quote:
- Confirm SOC2 evidence package + time-to-deliver (security will need 7–10 business days for the standard evidence pack).
- Add a line item for managed autoscaling bursts (hot-pool H100 hours) so we don’t underprovision for their 5–10 minute spikes.
- Validate that the 6x H100 config includes KV-cache warmup and 1.5x headroom for model state growth.
- I’ll attach the finalized pricing workbook and an internal margin calc — we should land within their $80k/month target for 6x H100 if they sign a 12-month commitment with an upfront payment.

I can join the technical deep-dive; propose Fri 9:30–10:00 PT.

— Marissa
